checks.name: MTF curve DC normalization (max abs error)
checks.notes: Every measured curve has mtf[0] equal to one by construction.

checks.name: MTF curve range [0, 1] (max violation)
checks.notes: A passive system cannot amplify modulation; the estimator clips noise/window excursions to the physical range.

checks.name: MTF curve monotonicity, Gaussian full band (max rise)
checks.notes: A Gaussian transfer function is monotone non-increasing over [0, 0.5].

checks.name: MTF curve monotonicity, box main lobe (max rise)
checks.notes: A width-4 box transfer function is |sinc(4 f)|, which has a zero at 0.25 cycles/pixel and a sidelobe; monotonicity is enforced on the main lobe, and the sidelobe is documented rather than hidden.

checks.name: SNR spatial per-channel agreement (max abs error, dB)
checks.notes: snr_patch per R/G/B channel against 20 log10(mean / std) with the sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of the same synthetic patch.

checks.name: SNR spatial luma agreement (abs error, dB)
checks.notes: Rec. 709 luma (0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B) in linear light against the luma plane's own sample statistics.

checks.name: SNR temporal vs known noise (abs error, dB)
checks.notes: Pooled per-pixel temporal variance over 32 frames with a static fixed pattern (sigma=0.05) and temporal noise (sigma=0.01); reference uses the known temporal sigma, not the estimator under test.

checks.name: SNR temporal fixed-pattern rejection (temporal minus spatial, dB)
checks.notes: The temporal estimator must exclude the static fixed pattern, so it must exceed the single-frame spatial SNR by a material margin.

checks.name: SNR mono path agreement (abs error, dB)
checks.notes: A 2-D mono patch reports one 'mono' channel with the same spatial statistics; no colour channel is invented.

checks.name: DeltaE76 vs colour-science (max abs error)
checks.notes: Euclidean Lab distance on the Sharma, neutral, lightness, and hue-rotation pairs against colour.delta_E(method='CIE 1976').

checks.name: DeltaE2000 vs colour-science (max abs error)
checks.notes: CIEDE2000 with kL=kC=kH=1 against colour.delta_E(method='CIE 2000') on the same pair set.

checks.name: DeltaE identity (max abs error)
checks.notes: A colour compared with itself must have exactly zero difference.

checks.name: Sharma CIEDE2000 published pairs (max abs error)
checks.notes: The 34 published Sharma et al. (2005) pairs printed to four decimals; this is an independent published-source check on both implementations.

checks.name: measure_all RGB chart completeness (colour + SNR)
checks.notes: A synthetic ColorChecker-like display built from the scene reference Lab returns 24 valid colour patches and per-patch SNR for R, G, B, and luma.

checks.name: measure_all edge layout completeness (MTF + acutance)
checks.notes: A separate edge layout returns an MTF result (crossings may legitimately be null) and a finite acutance.

checks.name: measure_all MONO report (SNR without colour)
checks.notes: A MONO RenderedImage returns one 'mono' SNR channel per patch and no colour group; the skip is recorded in metadata.

checks.name: measure_all JSON serialization (NaN -> null)
checks.notes: to_json parses with a strict reader, carries no NaN/Infinity tokens, maps the not-reached MTF crossings to null, and round trips to to_dict().

diagnostics.name: Airy f/2.8 (diagnostic)
diagnostics.note: Diagnostic only, not a gate case: Airy f/2.8 never reaches MTF20 inside Nyquist and its MTF50 is closest to the band edge, where the ESF estimator and Hamming window carry more bias.
